exposure: choice of online or paper questionnaires
questionnaire delivery method (online first vs choice of online or paper)
cohort: 8,795 young people from the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC) born between April 1, 1991, and December 31, 1992
finding: Offering participants a choice of questionnaire completion methods (online or paper) increased response rates but was more expensive than offering online questionnaires first.
